title: OptiLite+
body:
Is your Minecraft laggy? Perhaps you are looking for a minimal optimization modpack?

Well then OptiLite+ is the perfect modpack for you!

OptiLite+ brings amazing performance in a minimal package!

Whether your Minecraft is not running well, or you just want to squeeze that last bit of FPS out of your game, this modpack is for you!

Also includes features such as new third person player animations for eating, looking at a map, climbing up ladders, and much more!
